title.narrative: Empowering Youth in Politics - Fellowship visit

description.narrative: On behalf of the VU-YPC partnership, we would like to introduce the VU-YPC Network activity, related to our current partnership project, The Political Leadership Academy (PLA), where we in regards to the project would go to Washington DC during the USA President Election 2024. One of the objectives is to meet young politicians to learn more about their strategies and experience navigating politics and policy in the American context. Furthermore, we would be filming short videos with young people about their views and opinions on politics, democracy and youth involvement. In the visit, we are hoping to learn more about politics in the USA, youth involvement, strategies in politics and how to engage youth the best way possible. There will be one (01) member from VU Marokko and two (02) members from YPC on the visit, who will all take their new knowledge back to the partnership, to enrich the conclusion of our comparative study within the PLA.
